prompt: Compose one complete original 30-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: bright acoustic swing with precise offbeat guitar chops. Instruments: acoustic rhythm guitar, violin, upright bass. Tempo 148 BPM. Distinct motif: syncopated rising fourth. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 20-second fast-montage film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:28, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: A lively, upbeat and energetic instrumental track featuring accordion, acoustic guitar, and bass, with a folk-jazz fusion feel. It has a cheerful and danceable rhythm.
